source.post_text: Update: A family who was celebrating their 5y/o child’s birthday at Joey Tomatoes pizzeria in Point Pleasant beach was berated by the owner for asking for a knife to cut a Birthday cake after they spent $250 for food & drinks. Allegedly they called before bringing it.Who’s right?

replies.text: Most restaurants have a no outside food or drink policy but would allow for exceptions for something like a birthday cake with permission. They said they called ahead. That’s just bad business.
replies.author: @kingofkings0247

replies.text: @JoeyTomatoes staff behavior was abhorrent, just outright assholes ruining a birthday party .
replies.author: @saralynne65

replies.text: The owner just “killed” her own restaurant
replies.author: @JimmyBenningho2

replies.text:
That business owner would have lost my business FOR LIFE.
Why would ANY business owner treat their customers like that?!
When you lose 1 customer, it could be 10. Word of mouth is the best, or worst, advertising one can get.
replies.author: @William02216755

replies.text: Wild they handled a kid’s birthday like that after a $250 tab. That’s not a one-off screwup, it’s a hospitality culture problem.
replies.author: decoy

decoy_rationale: Jumps from the incident to a tidy culture diagnosis instead of the messier anger or jokes in the real replies.
